items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: The only Vergis that I knew was not in the music business at all.

ctx.x: I just noticed in the article they mentioned so many of them. W.J. Voges, it has.
There was Joe Vergis who was a composer. He wrote Don't Leave Me Daddy. The only Vergis?
